arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS gerd_patients_receiving_omeprazole
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_gerd
  ON ca_gerd.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
 AND ca_gerd.ancestor_concept_id = 318800
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de
  ON de.person_id = co.person_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_drug
  ON ca_drug.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
 AND ca_drug.ancestor_concept_id = 923645;
